t: Macheng (city information)
s: October 25, 2025 - Macheng means "Horse City" in Chinese. The name is derived from the ancient legend that a general named Ma, who was a renowned horse breeder, established a city in this area during the Han Dynasty. The character "Ma" (马) in Chinese means horse, and "cheng" (城) means city.
